response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and demonstrated hands-on work with event-driven systems and AI-agent tooling at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing financial risk/credit systems — critical requirements for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy (TDD, CI/CD, workshops, open-source contributions)
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance
Lacks evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or building senior technical leadership layers
No clear production track record in real-time financial inference or model-agnostic AI architecture
